source.text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Tatlow Road
104 That portion of M.U. 6-09 in the Province of British Columbia contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing .4 km on either side of the midline of Tatlow Road at Km 13 south of Smithers, thence in a general easterly direction at .4 km on either side of the midline of Tatlow Road to the point of intersection with the midline of Chapman Road; thence in a general easterly direction at .4 km on either side of the midline of Tatlow Road to the most easterly point on the midline of Tatlow Road and southerly at .4 km on either side of the midline of Chapman Road for 1 km. [en. B.C. Reg. 176/89, s. 6.]
